genstudio.note: Published plotting package documents widget mode; genstudio/widget.py defines its own anywidget Widget. First available release is a development release, recorded separately from stable releases.

pynodewidget.note: Published React Flow integration exports NodeFlowWidget; released source defines anywidget subclasses in pynodewidget/widget.py.

jupyter-paint-segment.note: Published image segmentation widget exports SegmentWidget, implemented as an anywidget subclass in released source.

ipygeotiff.note: Published geotiff.js bridge defines a custom GeoTIFF widget with a non-builtin frontend module. Publication date is not repository or invention date.

ipygis.note: Published browser GIS bridge defines GISWidget with its own frontend module. Widget source is verified by 0.1.0; earlier package releases are not assumed to contain the widget.

marimo-toml-editor.note: Published TOML editor exports TomlConfigEditor, implemented as an anywidget subclass; documented for both Jupyter and marimo.

anymap.note: Published mapping library defines MapWidget and concrete mapping integrations. Counted as one distribution, not one entry per class.

anymap-ts.note: Separately published TypeScript-based mapping library defines its own MapWidget. Distinct distribution from anymap under the proposed package-level unit; project-family counts should group them separately.

anywidget-graph.note: Published interactive graph component exports Graph and defines an anywidget subclass in widget.py.

neo4j-viz.note: Published graph visualization package includes GraphWidget by 1.2.0 (2026-02-20). Its older HTML output and earlier package publication are not evidence of an earlier custom widget.

d2-widget.note: Published D2 diagram component defines D2Widget in the release artifact.

manywidgets.note: Published widget collection defines BaseWidget as an anywidget subclass. Counted once at distribution level.

inspect-viz.note: Published visualization package defines its own Component anywidget base in inspect_viz/_core/component.py.

mopaint.note: Published painting component exports Paint as an anywidget subclass; documented reusable API rather than an unpublished notebook example.

ipyketcher.note: Published molecular editor exports KetcherEditor with an anywidget implementation in the package source.

plotly.note: BaseFigureWidget is a traditional custom widget in 5.24.1 and an anywidget subclass in 6.0.0rc0, followed by stable 6.0.0. Dependency metadata first declares anywidget later, so its date is not used as the implementation date.

ipysankeywidget.note: SankeyWidget changes from the traditional implementation in 0.5.0 to anywidget in 0.6.0, retaining the component name.

emblaze.note: Viewer is a traditional custom widget in 0.10.6 and an anywidget subclass in 0.11.0 in the same package/module.

jupyter-rfb.note: RemoteFrameBuffer is a traditional custom widget in 0.5.4 and an anywidget subclass in 1.0.2 in jupyter_rfb/widget.py.

mols2grid.note: MolGridWidget transitions from a traditional implementation in 2.0.1a2 to an anywidget implementation in 2.1.0a1; stable anywidget evidence is also available in 2.1.0.

keplergl.note: KeplerGl is a traditional custom widget in 0.3.2 and an anywidget subclass in 0.4.0rc1. The observed adoption is a prerelease; stable adoption is not established by this snapshot.

custom-widget-test123.note: Published description explicitly identifies this as a test/demo widget. Retained as ecosystem evidence, excluded from the proposed reusable-package count.

demo-jupyter-wasm-widget.note: Published description explicitly identifies this as a test/demo widget. Retained as ecosystem evidence, excluded from the proposed reusable-package count.

demo-jupyter-wasm-webgpu-widget.note: Published description explicitly identifies this as a test/demo widget. Retained as ecosystem evidence, excluded from the proposed reusable-package count.

wasm-test-widget.note: Published description explicitly identifies this as a test/demo widget. Retained as ecosystem evidence, excluded from the proposed reusable-package count.
